module_summary: Odd-ratio clock divider: posedge and negedge modulo-N counters each drive a half-period clock, OR-ed into a 50% duty clk_div.

anchors.name: clk_div
anchors.why: Divided clock output, OR of posedge and negedge divided clocks.

anchors.name: cnt1
anchors.why: Modulo-NUM_DIV posedge counter shaping clk_div1; cnt2 is negedge twin.

anchors.name: clk_div1
anchors.why: Posedge divided clock high for first half count; clk_div2 is negedge twin.

groups.name: negedge_divider
groups.description: Falling-edge counter and divided clock, half-cycle offset.

groups.name: clock_combine
groups.description: ORs both divided clocks for 50% duty output.
